title: payment-api error-rate SLO burn
description: Customer support escalation: payment-api p95 latency reached 623ms (normally ~209ms) and error rate peaked at 1.1%.
root_cause_detail: A dependency upgrade shipped in payment-api v3.14.0 leaked buffers on every request.
expected_symptoms: payment-api memory_usage climbs gradually from ~52% to ~87% over ~80+ minutes
increasing GC / heap pressure logs on payment-api
payment-api p95 latency rises from ~209ms to ~623ms as memory grows
payment-api errors appear late, error rate up to ~1.1%
payment-api db_connection_utilization stays within normal range
deployment of payment-api v3.14.0 shortly before memory growth starts
resolution: Rolled back payment-api to v3.13.9 and pinned the library version.
